Complete congruence orbit census of all 33,554,432 binary matrices is implemented independently in two C programs, which agree on all 13 sizes/counts and sum 9,999,360. Every binary projective line is exhaustively enumerated, scheme containment via four coefficients agrees with independent GF4 evaluation at five projective points. All 13 incidence degree sums equal three times the number of contained lines. The finite class table proves universal bounds and unique extremizers.

value.rationale: Rational lines are the points of the natural Fano surface of a cubic threefold; their incidence with rational points is a geometric/arithmetic structure beyond the already-known matrix congruence class number. This complete classification proves a sharp one-/27-line spectrum, identifies unique projective extremizers, and supplies an intrinsic rational point–line incidence fingerprint separating all thirteen field forms. It differs materially from an arbitrary coefficient slice or a known-table recompilation and may be used in identifying twists and Fano geometries over the smallest field.
